items.summary: init on a partially present .harness/ (e.g. only contracts/) fails with 'config.json: not found' because main() treats any .harness dir as initialized before init runs.
writeJsonAtomic leaves a partial .tmp-* file and escapes a raw error (exit 1) when writing the temp file itself fails (e.g. ENOSPC).
resolveConfig/loadConfig accept non-object config (null, budget:null) without validation or defaults.
status crashes with internal error on malformed feature entries (missing id/status/title) instead of state_corrupt.
t.mjs ^<id>\b also matches names like 'F1 AC-1-foo' or 'F1 AC-1.2' (harmless under current naming).
Harness root is process.cwd(); running from a subdirectory reports 'not initialized' (no upward search).
SPEC section 5 gaps found while implementing F2 were backfilled in 562408f (re-approval semantics, id/section rule, run_steps, pattern case rules, invalid tier).

doctor checks flags only, not authentication — it reports gemini usable while gemini exits 41 (no auth). A run would fail at eval with exit_nonzero rather than adapter_unavailable. Consider a zero-cost auth probe per CLI or mapping known auth-error exits to adapter_unavailable.
Windows .cmd shim escaping is unit-tested but never executed on Windows; covered once F8 CI runs on windows-latest.
hooks/hooks.json SessionStart uses ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}; under Gemini (which also loads hooks/hooks.json) it expands empty and fails non-fatally. Verify a host-neutral command form.
v1 agents/*.md (model: claude-opus-5) are also loaded by Gemini as agents until F8 removes them.
Model names are not validated; a model like '--yolo' lands in argv as a flag. Reject values starting with '-' or pass --model=<v>.
run() ignores role; force readOnly for READ_ONLY_ROLES as defence in depth.
Nonexistent cwd is reported as adapter_unavailable (misattributed cause).
Non-numeric timeoutSec becomes NaN (1 ms timeout); detail text 'killed after undefineds' when omitted.
gemini error wrapper exiting 0 would be read as model JSON (theoretical today).
A model verdict with type:'result' and is_error is misread as a claude wrapper (contrived).
independence() is optimistic when one side uses the CLI default model; consider fresh-context when either model is unknown.
doctor's defaultProbe requires --version; a generic CLI without it reads as not installed.
Process-group kill cannot reach setsid/daemonized grandchildren (and Windows orphans); exec now destroys the pipes so close still fires, but the orphan keeps running.
Timed-out verify commands are rerun once (worst case 2x step_timeout_sec); consider not retrying timeouts.
Code that holds skip markers as data fails its own verify; F3 splits marker strings as a workaround. Consider a per-contract marker_exempt_paths frozen by the approval hash.
verify with cwd=root reports uncommitted core writes to .harness/features.json as a .harness change (false positive if the core ever leaves them uncommitted).
If timeoutSec < 2s exit grace and a background child holds the pipes after a clean exit, the result is reported as timeout.
killTree signals the process group after the leader exited; pgid reuse is theoretically possible (only while a member still holds the pipes).
[D1-adversarial] skip-worktree/assume-unchanged index flags hide working-tree changes from verify's git diff. Structural option: verify the committed tree in a clean checkout.
[D1-adversarial] clean filters configured via .git/info/attributes alter what git diff sees.
hooksPath points at a fixed <tmpdir>/harness-no-hooks-dir; on shared /tmp another local user could plant a hook that runs during git worktree add. Use a fresh mkdtemp dir or /dev/null.
Ignored untracked files (.gitignore, .git/info/exclude) are not scanned for markers or .harness paths.
Base-side vacuity runs in a clean worktree without installed dependencies, so a dependency-needing check fails on base for unrelated reasons (vacuous criterion scored non-vacuous).
Marker list misses t.Skipf/t.SkipNow, fit(/fdescribe(, *.skip.each, pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif (contract fixes 8 markers).
Self-verify on the integration branch (base == HEAD) marks every criterion vacuous; needs --base <pre-feature ref>.
'어떤 .*도' / '모든 .*에 대해' do not match across newlines (consider the s flag).
Non-string criterion skips rule 3 with only a warning.
run_steps as a string or with different case/whitespace ('Rollout', ' rollout') is not rejected; non-array run_steps is not an error.
approve pretty-prints the contract; a compact contract just under 20KB can exceed the byte limit after approval.
verify does not check the approval hash (wire in F6 via executableFeatures).
approve writes contracts one by one then features.json; an I/O fault mid-way can leave partial state.
Base-side vacuity runs without installed dependencies (node_modules), so a dependency-needing vacuous check can be scored non-vacuous.
Untracked symlinks and nested git repos are skipped by the untracked-content scan.
